description: An East Asian man with a topknot, in grey layered robes, sits at a wooden table and presses fingers to the wrist of a pale arm reaching in from the left, which rests on a small cushion. A bamboo-slip scroll lies on the table at right, its slips covered in rows of clearly drawn Chinese-style characters. Dark room with carved wooden cabinet and chair. The painting fills the frame with no border.
reason: The bamboo slips carry rows of distinct, character-like writing in the foreground, which counts as painted text. Repaint the slips as plain bamboo strips with no marks, or only faint unreadable texture.
